batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c STR Binny b JP Faulkner

batting.name: AD Mathews
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b STR Binny

batting.name: KM Jadhav

batting.name: NM Coulter-Nile
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b DS Kulkarni

balls.text: towards middle and leg again, Faulkner swat-pulls that in the gap again, this time along the ground, and long on cuts it to two
full on the stumps, Faulkner opens up and lofts it right in the gap between long on and deep midwicket for a one-bounce four
full on off, punched down to long off and he called for two immediately. Coulter Nile throws to the keeper's end while losing his balance and the ball goes towards the slips
fullish on the stumps, dabs it down to long on with a cross-bat shot

DD did not want that right now, misfield at long off for four! Rahane came down and chipped the low full toss down to long off for an easy single, Coulter-Nile ran in hard but the ball went right through him as he took his eyes off the ball. Rahane smiles, NCN apoligises, Duminy doesn't react
slow and in the block hole on middle stump, pushed down to long on and even a tired Rahane comes back quickly for the second
finds the block hole outside off, Rahane steers it to point for one
118.4kph, slower one on the pads, Rahane goes in the crease and whips that over the fine leg boundary with a big swing for six!
141kph, that's a quick bouncer as the batsman can't connect the pull, it goes well over him, and the keeper who loses the ball again
in the block hole on leg stump, inside edge towards short leg for one
gets the height, but not the distance this time as he lofts the ball on the off side and Mishra runs in from deep cover to catch that easily

it's full on the stumps, Nair goes low to get under it and tonks that over the deep midwicket fielder, right at the rope, for six! Agarwal jumped a long way at the boundary, the ball touched his right hand finger tips and then he crashed into the ad boards
in the yorker, finally, and he digs it out bit wide of midwicket. They thought of two but Mathews keeps it to one
full delivery and it's pushed back to the bowler
full on the pads again, clipped to deep midwicket for one
no, it's slower and fuller and Rahane walks down to loft that half-volley straight over the bowler's head for four more. Easy peasy for Rahane
tries the yorker, it's a low full toss on off and Rahane merely pushes that down the ground over Nair's head. Perfect timing and he gets four. Score goes past 150 and partnership past 100
misses the leg stump by an inch or two down the leg side as Rahane went across to off to clear the leg side but missed it
more orthodox shot now as it's angled into the pads and he steers it to deep midwicket
shuffles across to off now, it's a shorter delivery and he guides that with a swivel to clear short fine leg as the ball came in. Fifty for him
full toss on off now, mid off is in, and Nair only has to clear the one fielder to drive that for a one-bounce four
108kph, slower ball again outside off, Nair knows it's an offcutter and he hammers it over the midwicket boundary for six!
another slower one from Sandhu, steered to deep square leg for one

in the air again, two fielders coming under it and neither Zak nor Mishra can take it! Rahane came down for the slower ball, top-edged it high on the off side. Mishra ran back from cover, Zak from mid off and both dived but nobody got close to the ball and Mishra landed on top of Zak
turning away, he reverse-sweeps it gently and finds short third man. An inaccurate throw from Zak to the bowler gives them an overthrow too
drives that handsomely with the turn to deep cover. Iyer stops it this time
slightly straighter on the stumps, flicked against the turn towards deep midwicket and Nair manages to make it for the second
misfield in the deep for four! He used his feet again and drove that inside-out towards deep cover, Iyer ran in to take it on the bounce and it went through him
too wide outside off and turning away further, called a wide
dances down, doesn't let it turn and lofts it straight towards long on. Coulter-Nile was waiting there, he jumped to his left but it went just over him
short and turning away from outside off, Rahane cuts off the back foot and bottom-edges it to point
back of length and nipping in sharply, he has no room and gets an inside edge while trying to ramp it on off
angled in from length towards the stumps, inside edge onto the pads for one on the off side
too short, angling in and Rahane smacks that with a late pull over deep backward square to bring up his fifty
towards the stumps now and it's clipped to midwicket

another one put down, this one was much tougher though! Nair came down to hammer that, pulled the short ball and got a top edge high and fine on the off side, third man ran in and Tiwary dropped it despite running in a lot
short of length outside off and he slices that wide of deep third man for one
middle and leg stump line now, slog-swept to Sandhu at fine leg
bit slower outside off, pushes it uppishly to cover
bit too full and Nair chips it with the wrists over the non-striker in the air for a four
fuller on the stumps and it's flicked to deep midwicket
comes down the track to take it on the full and drives it back to the bowler
flighted full toss outside off, driven easily into the covers
angled into the pads and Nair helps it to fine leg for one off the pads
some width outside off, driven off the front foot towards deep cover for two
shorter and wider outside off, Nair chases with a cut and misses
gets some room outside off, Nair leans into it and drives it just past cover for four
fuller on the stumps, driven down easily for one to long on
back of length on middle, pushed down to long on for one
shortish around off and Rahane times that beautifully wide of deep midwicket with a short-arm pull for four. Didn't hit it all that hard, it was the timing and placement
slower bouncer cutting in from around off, Nair comes down again and gets an inside edge on to his body for a quick single
comes down the track and slashes that to the right of deep cover in the gap for two
on the off stump now and Nair pushes it back to the bowler
beats him outside off! Hardly any room, touch short of length and Nair pokes and misses
pretty full and straight around off, driven down to long on by turning the wrists
drives outside off with another edge, misfield at cover gives them one
straighter length delivery on off, he defends it back

dropped at deep cover, by Sandhu! Rahane lofted that without much power from the teo end of the bat, giving a steady start again, Sandhu ran in a little late from the deep and couldn't get under it properly while diving forward
closer to the stumps further and Rahane flicks it to leg with the angle
much straighter outside off, pushed back to the bowler
bit of width outside off for the fullish delivery, Naiur drives with an outside edge to third man
back of length on the middle stump, swatted off the back foot to long on for one
googly coming into the batsman from outside off, defends it late towards point for one
more towards middle and leg now and Nair slog-sweeps that wide of deep midwicket and long on for four comfortably  in the gap
fuller outside the off stump, driven down to mid off
outside off with some turn and Nair also finds deep cover with a drive
full and flighted well outside off, Rahane goes down on a knee and crunches that along the ground to deep cover
thicker inside edge onto Rahane's pads, quick single on the off side
that's at least the third time Jadhav has let the ball go through his hands, luckily no edge. Nair chased the ball outside off and misses, and the keeper conceded byes
drives the fullish delivery from off down to mid off
big appeal for lbw as this nipped in sharply, Rahane looked to play it on leg and luckily for him got an inside edge onto the pad and the umpire saw that
closer to off stump, punched firmly back to Mathews and he stops it with his right hand
doesn't bounce as much from back of length outside off, he defends it back
touch back of length outside off, punched to deep cover for one
tossed up on middle stump, driven just past the bowler to long off
flighted on the off stump, pushed back to the bowler
straighter one on the off stump, Nair defends it back
touch shorter outside off, he waits and defends it past slip with a thick edge for two
draws an edge straightaway with a flighted delivery outside off, making him drive and the thick edge beats short third man
defends the length delivery on off and the offcutter finds the inside edge to go to the leg side
the opening stand is broken, Watto is caught behind! Angling in from outside off, Watson only pushed at it and outside-edged it to the keeper. Bit of a juggle and he eventually caught it
short ball towards Watson's body, he pivots on the back foot and hammers that with a pull to the backward square leg boundary for a one-bounce four
similar delivery and he pushes it to deep cover now
outside off, it's coming in with the angle but Rahane runs it fine on the off side for a delicate four
back of length delivery from Mathews, tucked to midwicket
some width outside off, runs it down to third man for one
bit of width outside off, driven firmly on the off side and JPD at mid-off dives to his left to save three
chipped down the ground and it falls just short of mid on! It was on middle and leg, pretty full, Watson drove it down but not too hard
fuller outside the off stump, driven down to mid off for one
short of length outside off, punched straight to point
angled in towards middle stump, that wasn't a bad delivery but Rahane has flicked that beautifully to the square leg boundary with great timing, and great work of the wrists
straighter on the off stump, Watson defends it back safely
coming into the batsman too much now, Watson makes use of that and drives it on the leg side with a big follow through, bit of inner edge for four
no room now because of the angle, Watson defends it to point
too much room outside off, Watson rocks back and crashes that over point with a square cut for four
slightly slower one at 123kph outside off, Rahane taps it towards point
width outside off, touch short too and Rahane punches that off the back foot, wide of cover for a cracking four
errs on the pads and Watson flicks that in the air to the fine leg boundary. Zak takes a couple unhurried steps to his left and is then beaten by pace
pokes and misses outside off as the ball shapes away a little bit. Watson's bat was a fair bit away from the body
pace and bounce as NCN bangs in a bouncer outside off, Watson pulls and misses
touch short of length outside off, Rahane stays back and guides it wide of the slip fielder for a quick single
stays back and pushes the back of length ball into the covers
short of length delivery outside off, Rahane taps it to third man
fuller outside the off stump, Watson drives it square towards point and a bit of misfield gives them two
back on the off stump line, Watson leans forward and blocks it back
there's some noise as Watson swings outside off, stifled appeal from the keeper and Zaheer because there was no deflection. Umpire says no even though replays confirm there was some noise for sure
just inside the wide line as Watson goes after the widish delivery and misses again
this time way outside off with swing that takes it away further even as Watson chases, called wide
straighter one on the off stump, length delivery, and Watson defends it back
wide down the leg side with some swing as it goes past the batsman
bit of outswing now towards off stump, Watson watches and pushes it into the covers
more bounce from Sandhu! This was back of length outside off, hardly any room, as Rahane drives off the back foot and misses
gets some width to free his arms and he drives that uppishly with an upper edge because of the extra bounce, and it flies over point
not much room this time, Rahane stays back to defend on the off side
more swing outside off, touch back of length and Rahane guides it to third man in the gap
outside the of stump again, with some swing and Rahane pokes and misses
129.8kph, back of length outside off, he defends towards cover for a quick single
angles it across Rahane from off, he guides it to third man with the outside edge
errs down the leg side again, deflects off the pads to fine leg for a leg bye
back to middle stump line, and Watson clips it to midwicket
much fuller outside off now, Watson leans into it and drives straight to cover
width offered this time outside off, doesn't swing and Watson finds point
130.7kph, right on target now. Inswing again for the length delivery coming in towards middle stump, Watson defends solidly
inswinging wide down the leg side past the pads, and the keeper can't hold on to it
yorker to end the match too, outside off, and he steers it to third man where the fielder cuts it off for two
he goes a long way to off, Southee delivers a yorker by chasing the batsman and they sneak in a bye. Samson gets a direct hit at his end and overthrows give them two more
towards the stumps and Tiwary hammers that with a powerful pull to the wide long on boundary for a cracking six!
he's bowling like Dhawal and delivers a wide way outside off for a wide
tries to slog and gets an inside edge just past the stumps for one
he moves a bit towards the leg side to cut that on off but misses it. There was some sound acutally as the ball went past the bat, Southee appealed all alone and the umpire didn't move
full outside off, Tiwary drives that firmly through the covers and a fumble in the deep gives them three
swings and misses as Mishra makes room to target the off side but misses as he swings his bat
almost a yorker this time, Tiwary punches that down the ground towards long off for two
another full toss, Tiwary comes down and smashes that through the covers in the gap for four!

can't clear Smith at long off this time! Another poor delivery, this was a full toss outside off, NCN lofted that high down the off side and it could have cleared the boundary. But Smith kept his cool at the boundary and took it near his shoulders with his fingers pointing up
to add to that, Coulter-Nile gets under that fullish delivery and tonks that with abig heave on the leg side, over deep midwicket for a six in the crowd
Watson doesn't look happy as Kulkarni now bowls a wide way outside off for another wide
and he bangs in a bouncer down the leg side for a wide
block hole well outside off, Tiwary blocks it on the off side for one
full and wide way outside off, called wide as it's left alone

fullish outside off, Duminy goes across and ramps that straight to short fine leg. He went down on a knee for the full delivery, got the middle of the bat but could not clear the fielder in the circle
tries the block hole outside off, JPD taps it just wide of point, where Bhati tumbles to his left but can't stop it
low full toss is driven down wide of long off and Duminy gets two
almost a yorker just outside off, driven to cover for a quick single
slow and in the block hole outside off, he makes room and steers it to deep point for one
back of length outside off, pulled to deep midwicket for one
full on off, drilled down to mid off where Faulkner dives and saves a few runs
fuller and wider outside off, Tiwary doesn't move much and chases and misses
that's hit the roof of CCI! Short ball again, and he got into position early, Tiwary then clobbered that high and even over the crowd in the stands for a massive six!
short of length towards middle and he takes some pace off the ball, pulls it to leg for one
slightly short and Tiwary pulls that towards deep long on for one

shortish ball is pulled by Duminy, Bhatia runs a long way to his right from deep square leg, slides and keeps the ball in. But the ball is rolling away to the rope, Bhatia gets up and then cuts it in again!
fullish just outside off, pushed towards point from the crease for one
taps the back of length ball towards point off the back foot for one
slow offcutter from leg to middle, tucked towards deep midwicket for one

top edge goes high on the off side, and Watson runs back from cover to pouch it safely! He swiped the ball to the leg side from outside off, didn't time it at all and the ball gave Watson enough time to run back and catch
clears his front foot to pull the short ball but doesn't middle it and it goes to long on
first he made room and then went back in the crease to tuck that fine on the leg side
too slow and down the leg side, Duminy drives and gets an edge towards mid on for one
takes a step down and pushes the length ball down to long off
a fair bit outside off now, Jadhav swings his arms but finds cover
115kph, slower one? Maybe...Jadhav went down on a knee for the short of length delivery and swept that over midwicket for a clean six!
some room outside off and it's punched to sweeper cover for one
widish delivery outside off, Duminy chases and gets a bottom edge on the off side
angled into the batsman, steered to deep backward square for one
that's another wide down the leg side
late reaction from Dhawal at fine leg and he can't get under it! The short ball induced a pull a top edge which went high behind square on the leg side but the fielder ran in late from his position
hits Jadhav's foot on the full outside leg, and it goes down to the keeper

faint outside edge and Samson takes an excellent catch diving forward! The length delivery didn't come in that much and Mathews stuck his bat out for the outside edge. The keeper did very well to get his gloves under it
touch shorter on the off stump, he shuffles across scoops that by going down on a knee, over the short fine leg fielder for a one-bounce four
length delivery outside off, no room, and Mathews blocks it back
full and wide down the leg side for a wide
gets a full delivery again and he whips this one by bisecting the gap between long on and deep midwicket for another boundary!
slower ball pitched up and Duminy tonks that high and far down the ground. Well into the crowd for a six over long on
back of length outside off, punched off the back foot to deep cover
keeps a bit low outside off and he punches that down to long on for one
offcutter from leg to middle, JPD goes back and works it to deep square leg with gentle hands for two
short of length outside off, square-driven off the back foot to point
yorker on middle and leg, and Mathews flicks that between fine leg and deep backward square leg for two
Mathews gets the middle of the bat for four! He turns on the back foot for the bouncer and hooks that just wide of fine leg. That was traveling fast
another edge as JPD tries to cut the ball behind point but gets an inner edge
short ball swinging into him, swat-pulls it behind square on leg in the gap for two
fullish on the off stump, Duminy lofts it down the ground, but not from the middle, and long on is interested. Southee jumps at the boundary but it goes over him
another lbw appeal as Duminy is struck in front of leg, it was swinging down leg
brings this one back into the batsman as he goes on the back foot, to appeal for lbw, but it was going down leg
short ball outside off and Mathews taps it to point for a quick single. Rahane tries a direct hit at the keeper's end but misses and concedes an overthrow
shot ball into the ribs, swat-pulls it with an inner edge towards deep midwicket
this one rises on him as he goes to the back foot, defends it to cover point
misses it again! This one's not a wide as it was short and had room outside off, Mathews threw his bat at it but in vain
stays back this time to cut the short ball outside off, it moves away further and Faulkner can't believe it's called a wide
gives him the charge to smash it to leg but the back of length ball beats him outside off
appeal for lbw as this one nips in sharply and hits him on the back foot in front of middle, but it's too high
tries to drill that through the covers but the inswing gets a bottom edge
charges down to take it on the full but the ball lands outside off and beats his poke with swing and they go for a bye. Samson has a shy at the stumps but misses
half-hearted appeal for caught behind as Watson bangs in the bouncer, Mathaws looks to hook it late and misses. Went just over the bat
length delivery on the off stump with some outswing, Mathews goes back to block it
that swings a lot way from full length outside off, Mathews leaves and it nearly goes to first slip
low full toss on middle stump, steered to deep square leg for one

looked like it would go all the way, but Binny has taken that out of nowhere at deep square leg, Yuvraj is stunned! Short ball, something bowled often against Yuvi these days, and he pulls that with a smack, but Binny jumps near the boundary rope to his left and falls just inside the line to send him back
touch fuller outside off, driven off the front foot to deep point for one
beats him this time as the ball nips away a bit, JPD poked and missed it
short of length with some room and angling in, JPD stays back and glides it wide of point, using the pace of the ball for four
back of length just outside off, Yuvi runs it down to third man for one
swing and a miss! This was pretty wide outside off, Duminy threw his bat at it away from his body and missed it
bangs it in a bit outside off now, JPD lets it go
swings it down the leg side. Looked like a wide, maybe it got something on the way
edged as he goes hard at it, to third man for one! There was a bit of width outside off, Yuvraj slashed and the outside edge flew to third man
some room outside off now, Yuvi taps it to point
swings it into Yuvraj, his bat comes down late and he defends it back
short of length again and nips in to trouble him again, inside edge towards leg stump for a quick single
he's troubling Yuvi here! This one went through the defence as Yuvi expected some bounce from the back of length delivery and went on his toes, the ball nipped in and went just over the stumps
touch shorter towards the stumps, JPD goes back and tucks it to mid on for one
looked like a slower delivery but it was normal pace at 134kph and JPD defended it back
this one comes in sharply towards the batsman, he crouches a bit and defends it with an edge not too far from the stumps
away-swinging delivery from outside off, Yuvraj lets it go
defends the short of length delivery on off but inside edge goes towards backward square leg and JPD calls for one
three in a row, this one is back of length outside leg, Yuvraj only swats it fine down the leg side to beat the keeper for four
on the other side now - width outside off and on length, he leans into it and drives that handsomely through the covers for four more!
that's quick and short, and Yuvraj pulls that with some wristwork to the square leg boundary for four!
swings it in with extra bounce into the batsman towards the ribs, Yuvraj defends it to leg
firm drive down the ground to mid off for the full delivery outside off
gets it right outside off with the angle, Yuvraj lets it go
third wide of the over down the leg side
that's a sharp inswinger towards middle stump, Yuvraj only defends it back with a punch, right from the middle of the bat and it beats a wide mid off for four!
fullish outside off, Duminy drives it nicely to the right of mid off for one
full on the pads with a bit of shape, helped to fine leg for one
even wider down the leg side with more swing. Wide again
swing again, this time it's full and down leg for a wide
swings it into Yuvraj, who is crammed for room and defends it to midwicket
inside edge onto the stumps, first ball! The ball was well outside off, Iyer pushed at it away from the body without any footwork and edged it on to off and middle stumps
similar length, on middle and leg now and Duminy pushes towards mid on
on length outside off, JPD leans forward and pushes it to cover
angled into the pads, it deflects to short fine leg for a leg bye
slower legcutter on the off stump, he tries to heave on leg and only finds mid on
back of length on the stumps now, punched back and Southee stops with his right hands
length delivery on the off stump, pushed back to Southee
bangs it in shortish and it sits up, Duminy calmly pulls it over the deep square leg boundary
hint of movement into the left hander but it starts outside the leg stump
much fuller, on the stumps, Duminy is up to it, just eases it straight past the bowler and the timing takes care of the rest
back of a length ball defended towards covers
Binny strikes immediately, Agarwal has played on, stayed back in the crease to a climbing delivery, tried to dab it with an angled bat, managed a thick inside edge
he;s got hold of it this time, made some room and just bashed this short of a length ball over the long off boundary
back of a length, just holding the line outside off, pushed away off the back foot
and this is pitched up much fuller, gets him to drive loosely, produces the edge with some away shape but that flies over and between keeper and lone slip
allows this one to come in around off and opens the face to guide it to cover
has a swish at this widish ball but it came in just a bit and beat him again
holds the line against the incoming angle now, from just short of a length, pushed away off the back foot
that has gone through him, came back in from a length after pitching, way past the inside edge, and bouncing just over the stumps
short of a length but he gets on his toes, rides the bounce and guides it nicely past point, lovely timing
tries to cut but there is plenty of lift on this shortish ball and he is beaten
that has gone through Hooda's grasp at square leg, was a back of a length ball tucked in the air, was dying to the fielder's right as he dived for it
advances down the track and has a swish but is beaten as the back of a length ball swings away
angles it in, straightens it sharply outside off, it is dabbed square but Rahane stops it with a dive to his left at backward point
pushes at a pitched up away swinging delivery outside off and it runs along the ground to third man
just back of a length, cramping him for room, he nudges it close to the pitch on leg and they scamper a single
